name: New York
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: New York Riesling generally has a light body and a light, mellow flavor.

blurb.text: A US wine state and the country's third-largest grape producer. American grapes such as Concord make up the largest share of its vineyards, ahead of hybrids and then vinifera. Its AVAs include the Finger Lakes and Long Island.
